home.title: ECO ARCH | Home design and renovation in Hanoi

services.title: Three clear home design packages | ECO ARCH
services.description: Choose 2D preliminary design, architectural design or integrated architectural and interior design. See what each includes, then book a call with ECO ARCH.

prelim.title: 2D preliminary design for existing homes | ECO ARCH
prelim.description: Preliminary design package: one 2D plan option for your existing home, with notes on function, sun and ventilation. For before you need 3D views.

architectural.title: Architectural design for renovations | ECO ARCH
architectural.description: Architectural design package: plan, elevations, sections and perspectives to picture your home after renovation. AI-assisted, architect-checked.

integrated.title: Integrated architectural and interior design | ECO ARCH
integrated.description: Integrated package: a full design, architectural and interior perspectives and detailed documents per contract, for construction preparation. Book a call.
